data.one_liner: Wraps an object in a dedicated isolate and forwards method calls to it
data.what_it_does: Creates a separate isolate for an object and forwards method calls to that isolate, keeping timer or event-loop driven work running even when the main isolate is blocked. The API is simple: evaluate closures and close the isolate.
use_when: Heavy synchronous work blocks the UI and you need background processing
You want to isolate a simple object that can be sent across isolates
You need a lightweight, dependency‑free solution for background tasks
avoid_when: The object needs to access the UI or platform channels
You require many isolates or complex inter‑isolate communication
You need advanced features like state management or dependency injection
strengths: Simple API with evaluate and close
Keeps event loop free for timers and animations
weaknesses: Only works with objects that can be sent across isolates
No support for platform channels or UI access
